Every name and time the mentor uses appears in the tool output, including Subtitle's Position 0.3 to 1.3 s and 1.3 to 4.37 s (4.367 rounded), the key at 1.3 s, and Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, and Title/Bar/Glow's properties from left_out; Turn 8's 'ease Title's Position and Scale again' matches the ease_first refs.
